1.name: sky
1.description: The sky. It fills the top half of the painting. Deep blue at the very top, lighter blue in the middle, and a soft peach and orange glow where it meets the hills.

2.name: clouds
2.description: Two small white clouds, soft and puffy. One floats near the top of the tree on the left. The other drifts in the upper right corner.

3.name: sun
3.description: The setting sun. A glowing orange circle, right of center, half hidden behind the big hill. It is brightest and pale yellow at its center.

4.name: hills
4.description: Blue-green hills that stretch across the whole painting. They are low on the left and rise into a large, rounded hill on the right, where the sun is setting.

5.name: field
5.description: A yellow-green field that covers the bottom third of the painting, warm and grassy, like late summer.

6.name: path
6.description: A sandy tan path. It starts wide at the bottom center of the painting and winds up and to the right, getting narrower until it disappears into the hills.

7.name: tree
7.description: A tall tree on the left side of the painting. A straight brown trunk rises from the field, topped by a big, rounded, dark green crown of leaves shaped like a cloud.
